questions.text: What is the role of financial intermediaries in addressing issues of asymmetric information?

options.a: They eliminate the need for information disclosure in financial transactions.
options.b: They help reduce asymmetric information by conducting due diligence and providing information to both parties.
options.c: They create more asymmetric information by withholding critical market data.
